mainEntity.name: What happens after the preliminary scope and budget are finalized?

acceptedAnswer.text: Once the preliminary scope and budget are approved, the project transitions into detailed architectural drafting, structural engineering, and formal preconstruction development. During this phase, your contractor and designer coordinate to ensure construction drawings adhere to the agreed budget limits. You will finalize material specifications, window schedules, and interior finishes. After engineering and construction documents are complete, Total Building Systems Inc. solicits firm subcontractor bids to convert the preliminary framework into a final, binding construction contract and submits plans for permitting.
